<application>
<!-- Unique ID to identify this project, recommend using reverse domain name notation --> <id>net.netacad.cisco.ladder_logic_runtime</id> <version>1.1</version> <name>Ladder Logic Runtime</name>
<!-- Optional tags --> <description>Executes Ladder Logic</description> <author>Packet Tracer Team</author> <contact/>
<!-- If this app is to be installed on the Desktop, provide this tag and its children. <gui> <name>Ladder Logic Runtime</name> <html>main.html</html> <icon>icon.png</icon> <background>true</background> </gui> -->
<!-- If this app is to provide commands in the Command Prompt, provide this tag and a command tag for each command. --> <cli> <command> <name>ladderlogic</name> <description>ladder logic info</description> </command> </cli>
<!-- If this app is to be exported, you can specify the devices that this app will automatically installed on. Either the gui or cli tag is required. Possible values are PC, Laptop, Server, Tablet, Smartphone, SBC, Thing. --> <auto-install> <device>PLC</device> </auto-install>
<auto-run>true</auto-run>
</application>
